responsibility: Describes the Itanium 2 pipeline, functional units, bypasses, and bundle formation rules for the IA-64 scheduler using GCC’s DFA automata language. It maps ia64.md instruction classes to reservation and bundling behavior when tuning for processor_itainum2, allowing the scheduler and final bundling logic to model issue slots, hazards, stop bits, and instruction-group composition specific to that microarchitecture.
